edit.new: the inner V-01 gets **no** `:aspect` and **no** modal triple; it only gets the temporal triple `(<governing verb> :overlap V)`.

edit.text: In Chinese documents a named human is `individual-person`, not `person` (`(individual-person :name (name :op1 "格内洛索" :op2 "·" :op3 "波普"))`); keep `person` for pronouns and unnamed people.

edit.old: - Every event and time expression has a temporal parent; every event has a modal parent.
edit.new: - Every event and time expression has a temporal parent; every event has a modal parent (except the inner verb of a V+量 compound, which has only a temporal parent).
